added.name: Dreamscale Labs
added.long_description: Dreamscale Labs is building the fastest cloud inference platform for robotics. As complex physical AI models become difficult to fit on expensive on-robot GPUs, we let users offload inference to the cloud and serve them with real-time latency. So far, we've hit 40-50% lower latency than existing neoclouds.
added.one_liner: Running robot brains in the cloud

long_description.before: Ara is the cloud coding agent — an autonomous software engineer for software teams. It watches work in progress, plans the next step, and executes tasks with its own computer, background agents, persistent memory, and reusable skills. Unite your team that uses Claude and Codex and other  coding subscriptions to code together in the browser. Ara turns coding into a closed loop: suggest, act, learn, improve.

long_description.before:
Verdant is building the AI infrastructure for local government, and we’re starting with the highest volume workflow in local gov that requires judgement: permitting.

We are the system of record and the analysis layer on top so every decision a government makes get made on better information, faster. In just two months we've processed 200+ permits and gone from 0 to 4 paid deployments across 4 states.
long_description.after:
Verdant prepares local governments for the agentic era. Agents will interact with local governments at volumes and speeds that legacy software and workflows can't handle. Verdant builds both the system of record for agents and internal agents that let local government workflows keep up. 

We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgement.

one_liner.before: AI-native planning & permitting software for local gov
one_liner.after: AI infrastructure for local government, starting with permitting

long_description.before:
Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team.

The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first design partner had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production.

A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption.

Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.

long_description.before: Rational builds AI employees for in-house enterprise accounting teams. Enterprises process high volumes of complex, multinational transactions that require broad expertise in international tax and accounting. Powered by the most accurate tax model in the world, we save teams enormous time on tax and close work while also eliminating unnecessary audit costs.

long_description.before:
Qlo uses AI agents to run commercial underwriting operations from submission to renewal. Specialized agents handle each operational step, while supervisor agents coordinate the work and communicate with the underwriter.

Every commercial insurance program will be built and operated end to end by AI agents on Qlo.
long_description.after:
Qlo builds AI agents to run commercial insurance underwriting. We start by fully automating the operational work around risk decisions, become the system of record, and earn autonomy workflow by workflow toward the autonomous AI underwriter.

We’re rebuilding underwriting infrastructure from the ground up so human underwriters and AI agents can share the same accounts, rules, documents, permissions, and workflow state. 

We believe every commercial insurance program will eventually be built and operated end to end by AI agents on Qlo.

long_description.before:
Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics, already tops the Physics IQ benchmark.
It has been action conditioned, so you can simulate robot actions within it.
This lets Robot Labs train their robots using GPUs instead of relying on human collected manual data that is slow and expensive.
In unseen and hard to replicate environments, this is the only path to getting ANY training data.
